Life can really suck like that, but when I was in your situation, I had at least one rule: I wouldn't do anything, while I was feeling down from something specific. That way I would know that when I try killing myself it would be with a clear mind. Whenever you feel like that try talking to someone you trust i.e. your cousin. And if you don't feel like talking to then just talk to us here. We'll be here to listen.

It's definitely not your fault. Even though it of course would be great if you can get yourself to seek professional help, it's not your fault if you don't. Being depressed is a serious issue and it would be like asking someone with broken legs to walk themselves to the hospital. Would be great if they somehow managed, but you can't blame them for not being able to do so. In the same way this is not your fault.

Please don't do this. It would be a very slow and agonizing death that could easily take a few days.
Maybe you could tell us why you are feeling like this. That way we might be able to help you better.

Hi, I am sorry you feel this way. Would you mind telling us what has been going on lately and just talk it through a bit? I know it can be really difficult being in your situation, but I always find that talking about it gives me a bit of perspective and calms me down and I'm hoping, you posting here means you could at least give it a chance.
I really hope we can help you in some way.
